mapper.select: SELECT f.*, u.name AS user_name, u.student_id AS user_student_id, admin.name AS admin_name FROM feedback f LEFT JOIN users u ON f.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users admin ON f.admin_id = admin.id WHERE f.id = #{id}

SELECT f.*, u.name AS user_name, u.student_id AS user_student_id, admin.name AS admin_name FROM feedback f LEFT JOIN users u ON f.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users admin ON f.admin_id = admin.id ORDER BY CASE f.status WHEN 'open' THEN 0 WHEN 'in_progress' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, f.created_at DESC

SELECT f.*, u.name AS user_name, u.student_id AS user_student_id, admin.name AS admin_name FROM feedback f LEFT JOIN users u ON f.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users admin ON f.admin_id = admin.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feedback (user_id, type, title, content, status, admin_reply, admin_id, handled_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{adminReply}, #{adminId}, #{handledAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE feedback SET type = #{type}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, admin_reply = #{adminReply}, admin_id = #{adminId}, handled_at = #{handledAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
